# Describe the cohort {.unnumbered}

Before we model an outcome, who is in the cohort and how do the measurements
relate to one another? Start with the dataset and its Table 1, then choose the
display that lets a clinical reader see the distribution, comparison, trajectory,
or study flow that matters.

## Choose the next recipe

| Your question | Recipe | Why this one |
|---|---|---|
| Who is in this dataset and what values need attention? | [Describing a dataset](data_tables.qmd) | Takes inventory before a figure or model hides the detail. |
| How do I make a publication table from a data summary? | [Publication tables](qt_tables.qmd) | Formats a summary for a report or manuscript. |
| How do I prepare the manuscript's Table 1? | [Manuscript tables](hv_tables.qmd) | Builds the descriptive table readers expect. |
| What does the distribution of one continuous measure look like? | [Histogram plots](histograms.qmd) | Shows counts across meaningful bins. |
| Is the distribution smooth, skewed, or multimodal? | [Density plots](density.qmd) | Shows the shape without committing to bins. |
| How do groups compare on a continuous measure? | [Box plots](boxplots.qmd) | Shows center, spread, and outlying values by group. |
| How many observations fall in each category? | [Bar chart plots](bar.qmd) | Makes categorical counts or proportions easy to compare. |
| Do two continuous measures move together? | [Scatter plots](scatter.qmd) | Shows the relationship one observation at a time. |
| How does each patient change across repeated measurements? | [Spaghetti plots](spaghetti.qmd) | Preserves the within-patient trajectory. |
| How do several outcomes fit into a compact small-multiple display? | [Postage stamp plots](postagestamp.qmd) | Repeats one clear view across outcomes or groups. |
| How did patients move through the study? | [CONSORT patient-flow diagrams](consort.qmd) | Documents cohort assembly and exclusions. |
| Which sets of patients overlap? | [Venn diagrams and UpSet plots](upset.qmd) | Shows intersections more clearly than a long list of counts. |
| How does a cohort move between categories? | [Alluvial and Sankey plots](sankey.qmd) | Traces flows from one state to the next. |
| Did treatment groups balance before and after adjustment? | [Covariate balance and follow-up](balance.qmd) | Checks the comparability needed before outcome interpretation. |
